query: NVIDIA Data Center revenue Q2 fiscal 2025 growth drivers AI demand
normalized: 2025 ai center data demand drivers fiscal growth nvidia q2 revenue

output.content:
NVIDIA’s Data Center revenue was **$26.3 billion in Q2 FY2025** (quarter ended July 28, 2024), representing **16% sequential growth** and **154% year-over-year growth**; it accounted for approximately **87.5%** of the company’s $30.0 billion total revenue. [[1]] 

The principal driver was exceptionally strong demand for NVIDIA’s **Hopper GPU computing platform and associated networking**, as customers continued to build and modernize AI infrastructure for generative-AI workloads. [[2]] [[1]] 

Demand was broad-based across **frontier-model developers, consumer-internet companies, and enterprises deploying generative-AI applications**, rather than originating from only one customer class. [[2]] 

At the workload level, NVIDIA identified generative-AI **model training and inference** as key contributors, alongside CUDA-enabled data preprocessing and post-processing for video, images and text, synthetic-data generation, AI recommendation systems, and SQL/vector-database processing. [[2]] 

The growth also reflected expanding sales of **networking** products: compute revenue rose more than 2.5x year over year, networking revenue more than doubled, and Ethernet-for-AI revenue doubled sequentially as hundreds of customers adopted NVIDIA Ethernet offerings. [[2]] 

Product-cycle dynamics further supported demand: the **H200 platform began ramping** during Q2 with large cloud service providers, customers were accelerating Hopper purchases while preparing to adopt Blackwell, and NVIDIA said Hopper demand remained strong with Blackwell demand anticipated to exceed supply. [[2]] 

In short, the 154% increase was driven by hyperscale and broader enterprise AI-capex demand for Hopper-based accelerated computing and networking, expanding inference as well as training workloads, and customers positioning capacity for the subsequent Blackwell platform transition. [[2]] [[1]]

sources.title: NVIDIA Corporation - NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2025
